import json
prog = currentProgram
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
out = {}
for key, a in {"despawn_caller1": "0x141bcc540", "despawn_caller2": "0x141bd92e0", "replay_caller1": "0x140e9c870", "replay_caller2": "0x141bcd720", "recalc_caller1": "0x141bcc6d0", "recalc_caller2": "0x141bda800", "tmb_caller1": "0x141bcc3b0", "tmb_caller2": "0x141bda0c0", "convert_caller1": "0x141bcb200", "convert_caller2": "0x141bdb260", "despawn_wrapper": "0x141bb2110"}.items():
    addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress(a)
    f = fm.getFunctionContaining(addr)
    if f is None:
        out[key] = None
        continue
    out[key] = [str(f.getEntryPoint()), str(f.getBody()), str(f.getName())[:4000]]
with open("/tmp/tree-rest-callers.json", "w") as fh:
    json.dump(out, fh)
print(json.dumps({k: (v[0] if v else None) for k, v in out.items()}))
